mapper.sql: r.id, r.request_no, r.case_number, r.real_name, r.gender, r.card_number, r.birthday, r.age, r.age_type, r.home_address, r.visit_date, r.noon, r.department_id, d.dept_name AS department_name, r.employee_id, e.real_name AS employee_name, r.regist_level_id AS registration_level_id, rl.regist_name AS registration_level_name, r.settle_category_id AS settlement_category_id, sc.settle_name AS settlement_category_name, r.is_book AS booked, r.regist_method AS registration_method, r.visit_state, r.regist_money AS registration_fee, r.created_at

FROM `register` r JOIN department d ON d.id = r.department_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id JOIN regist_level rl ON rl.id = r.regist_level_id JOIN settle_category sc ON sc.id = r.settle_category_id
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.department_id, e.regist_level_id AS registration_level_id, d.dept_name AS department_name, e.real_name AS employee_name, rl.regist_name AS registration_level_name, rl.regist_fee AS registration_fee, rl.regist_quota AS registration_quota FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id AND d.active = TRUE JOIN regist_level rl ON rl.id = e.regist_level_id AND rl.active = TRUE WHERE e.id = #{employeeId} AND e.active = TRUE FOR UPDATE
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM settle_category WHERE id = #{settlementCategoryId} AND active = TRUE

where.if: AND (r.case_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.card_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge_item WHERE register_id = #{registrationId} AND state = 'PAID'
mapper.update: UPDATE charge_item SET state = 'VOID' WHERE register_id = #{registrationId} AND state = 'UNPAID'
UPDATE `register` SET visit_state = #{targetState} WHERE id = #{id} AND visit_state = #{expectedState}
